posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
Just a note for art fanatics, but the latest update to the Sentinels Sidekick includes a pack for Wrath of the Cosmos so you can preview some of the art, including Guise, Wager Master and Omnitron IV. It also incluxdes the art for the backs of the Prime Wardens and Rogue Agent K.N.Y.F.E. promos (and 'Kvothe Argent Adept but we've already seen that, although this is higher resolution), but no text, so while we can see how gorgeous the art is, we can't see what they do until the shipping container escapes.

EDIT: You only get Sky-Scraper's Normal sized card, which is a shame as her Tiny incap is one of the best, IMHO.
